title: Work IQ: how agents reach Microsoft 365 and business data, and what an admin can switch off
summary: The documented controls, commands, billing rate and revised enablement schedule are supported. Minor qualifications concern differing Business Applications preview descriptions and the general Features reference's environment-security-role requirement.

claims.claim: Work IQ is Microsoft's workplace intelligence layer for agents and applications reasoning over organizational data.
claims.quote: Work IQ is a workplace intelligence layer that enables agents to access and reason over organizational and business data, context, and tools.

claims.where: summary; What it is: What it can reach
claims.claim: Business Applications in Work IQ adds Dynamics 365 and Power Apps data.
claims.quote: The Business apps (preview) workload provides context from Dynamics 365 and Power Apps.

claims.claim: Business Applications in Work IQ is described as preview.
claims.quote: Some workloads, such as Business apps (preview), are available in preview and require you to turn on preview workloads in the agent's settings.
claims.fix: Qualify the blanket preview description: 'The Copilot Studio page labels Business apps as preview; the Power Apps user guide says access through Work IQ MCP and Copilot Studio is generally available, while Cowork access is public preview.' Add https://learn.microsoft.com/power-apps/user/use-business-apps-work-iq to sources; that page explicitly states those availability distinctions.

claims.claim: Every Work IQ request runs in a signed-in user's context.
claims.quote: Actions are user scoped, meaning every request runs in the context of a specific user and only accesses what that user is allowed to see or do.

claims.claim: Work IQ exposes a remote MCP server, using Model Context Protocol for tool-based access.
claims.quote: The Work IQ MCP server exposes Microsoft 365 intelligence capabilities and connected enterprise sources to AI agents through the Model Context Protocol (MCP).

claims.claim: Work IQ has a REST API.
claims.quote: Work IQ API endpoints include A2A, a remote MCP server, and a REST API.
